title: Terms of service
lead: Welcome to Casely. These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Casely website and services. By browsing our website or placing an order, you agree to the terms outlined below.

sections.heading: 1. About Casely
paragraphs: Casely is a Ghana-based phone case brand focused on bringing personal style and creative expression to everyday phone accessories. We offer ready-to-ship and made-to-order phone cases, including customised designs.

sections.heading: 2. Orders and payments
bullets: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation.
Customers are responsible for ensuring that their selected phone model, design and delivery details are correct before completing an order.
Full payment is required before an order is processed unless otherwise stated.
Once an order has entered production, modifications or cancellations may not be possible.
Casely reserves the right to decline or cancel orders where necessary, including cases of pricing errors or product unavailability. Any payment received for an unfulfilled order will be refunded.

sections.heading: 3. Products and design variations
paragraphs: We make every effort to ensure that product descriptions, photographs and colours are represented accurately.

However, slight variations in colour, print placement, finish and appearance may occur due to screen differences and the nature of the production process. Such minor variations do not automatically constitute product defects.

sections.heading: 4. Order processing and delivery
bullets: Most Casely products are made to order. Processing times may vary depending on the product, order volume and production requirements.
Estimated delivery timelines are communicated during the ordering process or through customer updates.
Delivery timelines are estimates and may be affected by production or transportation delays.
Customers are responsible for providing accurate delivery information and being available to receive their orders.
Any significant delay will be communicated to the affected customer.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All original Casely branding, website content, graphics, photographs and designs remain the property of Casely or their respective owners.
Content may not be reproduced, distributed or commercially used without the appropriate permission.

sections.heading: 6. Customer responsibilities
bullets: Provide accurate order and contact information.
Ensure that their selected phone model is correct.
Use the products for their intended purpose.
Refrain from fraudulent transactions or misuse of the website.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: Casely is not responsible for damage resulting from improper use, accidents, negligence or normal wear and tear. Nothing in these terms excludes rights or remedies that customers are entitled to under applicable Ghanaian law.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: Casely reserves the right to update or modify these Terms of Service when necessary. Updated terms will be published on this page.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
paragraphs: For questions, concerns or assistance, customers may contact Casely through our official customer service channels.
